summary: xAI announced that Interactive Brokers customers can connect their brokerage accounts to Grok for portfolio analysis, scenario modeling, market research, and generating trading order instructions.

categories.reason: A brokerage platform integrates AI-driven portfolio analysis and order generation directly into its trading workflow, changing the product surface for a consumer finance business.
categories.quote: Interactive Brokers now integrates with Grok, bringing powerful AI directly into your trading experience — portfolio analysis, scenario modeling, research, and order instructions.
